{{Quote|Yes, redheaded. Like myself. And her mother&hellip;|Admiral Fraabaal, on his daughter|<ref name="TOR:FC" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was a member of the [[Fraabaal family]] and the '''mother''' of [[Vereta Fraabaal]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who was the daughter of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Fraabaal]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]]. The woman had [[Color/Legends|red]] hair like her daughter, and had [[Death/Legends|died]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]]<ref name="TOR:FC" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> leaving Admiral Fraabaal heartbroken.<ref name="TOR:FC" />
